page.about.body: Undal is a cash-on-delivery food and grocery platform built for Bangladesh. No vendor can buy a higher position, no customer is charged a hidden fee, and every rider sees the full payout before accepting.
page.about.title: About Undal
page.app.body: The customer app is on Android. On an iPhone, this website does everything the app does.
page.app.title: Get the app
page.contact.body: Reach a person, not a bot. Support answers in Bangla and English every day from 09:00 to 23:00 (Asia/Dhaka).
page.contact.title: Contact
page.help.body: Answers to what customers ask most, and what to do when something goes wrong.
page.help.s1.body: Open the order's tracking page. The timeline shows the state the platform last confirmed; if it has not moved in twenty minutes, send us the code.
page.help.s1.title: My order is late
page.help.s2.body: Tell us within the same day and keep the food as it arrived. Refunds go back to the method you paid with.
page.help.s2.title: Something is missing or wrong
page.help.s3.body: Cash on delivery cannot be charged twice, so a duplicate is almost always a bank hold. Send the order code and we will confirm what Undal actually collected.
page.help.s3.title: I was charged twice
page.help.title: Help
page.licence.body: Undal's source is public. Running it for real needs a licence.
page.licence.title: Licence
page.partner.lead: Menus, orders and payouts for the restaurants on Undal.
page.partner.notice: The browser build of the partner console is not shipped yet. Until it is, the same actions live in the Undal Partner Android app.
page.partner.s1.body: Publish a menu, pause a dish, accept orders, watch the day's payouts and answer a customer.
page.partner.s1.title: What the console does
page.partner.title: Partner console
page.privacy.body: We keep your phone number, addresses and order history to deliver your food and to satisfy tax law. We delete rider positions when a shift ends. We sell nothing to anybody.
page.privacy.s1.body: Your phone number, the delivery point you choose, what you ordered, and the order's states. Nothing else, and no advertising identifiers.
page.privacy.s1.title: What we collect
page.privacy.s2.body: Order records are kept for the period Bangladeshi tax law requires. A location is kept only with the order it was used to deliver.
page.privacy.s2.title: How long we keep it
page.privacy.s3.body: The kitchen sees the items and the note. The rider sees the delivery point and the phone number for that delivery. Nobody sees another customer's order.
page.privacy.s3.title: Who sees it
page.privacy.title: Privacy
page.rider.lead: Go online, take offers, and see what you earned today.
page.rider.notice: The browser build of the rider console is not shipped yet. Until it is, go online in the Undal Rider Android app.
page.rider.s1.body: Go online, accept or decline an offer, navigate to the kitchen and the door, and read the day's earnings.
page.rider.s1.title: What the console does
page.rider.title: Rider console
page.terms.body: The short version: we deliver what you ordered, at the price we quoted, and we tell you plainly when we cannot.
page.terms.s1.body: Anyone with a Bangladeshi mobile number and a delivery point inside an area a kitchen serves.
page.terms.s1.title: Who can order
page.terms.s2.body: The price you agree to is the price quoted at checkout, in taka, inclusive of VAT. Payment is cash on delivery until card and wallet payments are enabled.
page.terms.s2.title: Prices and payment
page.terms.s3.body: You can cancel until the kitchen accepts the order. After that, cancellation is at the kitchen's discretion and food already cooked is charged.
page.terms.s3.title: Cancellation
page.terms.title: Terms of service
